doc: About and licences: application, version, source revisions (GPL-3.0 corresponding source) and every bundled notice; «Подробная диагностика» (a switch, off by default, beside «Поделиться отчётом»); the studio's wordmark (Dustoff, a picture) under the licence note; a notice opens verbatim on parchment; «Отправить сохранение» lists the player's saves to share one (or all of them, «Все сохранения», when there are several); «Восстановить сохранение» opens the system file picker, asks when a save of that name is already there (dialog: replace / keep both / cancel) and shows the result (dialog). Filled by the engine's launcher.cpp.
